selection_rule: each tier is declared by a symmetry/completeness rule stated in PRIOR_DISCLOSURE_V1.md CH2; no tier member is chosen, removed, or tuned with reference to any family morphology

atoms_tier.rule: the task inputs themselves plus the minimal sign-symmetric constant set
atoms_tier.inputs: all battery input channels, by name from the battery freeze

binary_tier.rule: the single group law of the integer value domain (weakest structural assumption permitting signal mixing)

primary.rule: the complete set of one-sided order tests over the value domain D at every cut point, plus sign negation
members: GE_c for every c in D
primary.semantics: GE_c(v) = 1 if v >= c else 0 (pointwise over the row tuple); NEG(v) = -v

ablations.rule: ALL total unary maps D->D (fully complete tier); feasible only where |D|=3, i.e. guard [-1,1]
v1's audited coercive baseline {NEG, POS}; retained for CONTRAST ONLY; recovery claims may not rest on it

value_guard.derivation: smallest symmetric interval containing all signed sums of the atom constants and any two input bits (equals v1's guard for comparability)

cost_model.rule: uniform cost 1 per operator application, 0 per atom; multi-output machine cost = sum of output-port costs; no cross-port sharing credit (conservative for reuse claims)
cost_model.search: cost-layered dynamic programming over the semantic quotient (exhaustive per layer, dedup by exact I/O semantics); first layer containing the target = complete no-solution-below-cost certificate; termination = target found or layer saturation (no new semantics)
cost_model.layer_cap_derivation: 2x the largest minimal cost (7) observed across all v1 tranches; expected never to bind before saturation; outcomes must report whether it bound

search_procedures_for_flagship_robustnes.description: layer-wise exhaustive enumeration over the semantic quotient (dedup by exact semantics), min-cost representative per semantic value

independent canonical tree enumeration by operation count with a different canonicalization (subtree sort + commutative-ADD argument ordering), no semantic dedup across layers; verifies the DP via a procedure with disjoint implementation mechanics
